deficiencies.description: The text does not state that the tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus; the lecturer is pointing out the tumour and the outer surface of the uterus as separate locations on a visual specimen.

deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus

deficiencies.description: The rewrite replaces 'circumspect' with 'circumscribed'. Although 'circumscribed' is the likely intended medical term, resolving an unclear or misspoken word that was not provided in the corrections list constitutes a distortion.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: this is actually circumspect and very separate

deficiencies.description: The rewrite adds 'therefore', establishing a causal or consequential link implying that the tumour is circumscribed and separate as a result of the fixation and staining process, whereas the text used 'So you can see' as an observational remark demonstrating that the tumour had not invaded.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: has actually caused the tumor, which is, as I said, not invaded into the surrounding tissue to separate away from the normal muscle. So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
